title: JIT profile generator for hybrid shard routing (MoE + GQA) with telemetry-driven tuning
creator: Anika Shah
description: Build a Just-In-Time (JIT) performance-profile generator and verification pipeline that produces shard-aware kernel & compile hints for hybrid architectures (Mixture-of-Experts + Grouped-Query Attention). The generator will create lightweight runtime profiles that specify kernel selection, quantization preferences, launch configs, and cache/warmstart parameters per model-version/shard-class. Profiles must be safe to roll out via the existing pinning API and include a deterministic rollback path to a stable profile. Goal: reduce P95 generation latency by >=12% for large-sequence GQA/MoE workloads while keeping token cost neutral or better.
